attributes.name: Simulacrum of Vraxeris
attributes.powers:
Before the encounter, succeed at a Wisdom 10 check or recharge your hand then draw 1 card.

All damage dealt by the Simulacrum is Mental damage that may not be reduced.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close this location.
